title: Azusawa Kohane — The Biggest Bite I Can Muster〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: The Biggest Bite I Can Muster（4★）

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... Why don't we end practice here for today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it is getting pretty late.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speaking of which, we'll be flying over to the States soon. You guys all done packing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Aside from the things I'll still be using until the night before, my suitcase is all packed.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mine too. I even drew up a checklist to make sure I don't forget anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, you're so prepared!
Can you give me a copy later?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, all that's left is to hope for good weather and a smooth flight.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, the other day, my dad said, “If the weather is bad enough, I wonder if your flight might end up canceled.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I bet he's just lonely thinking he won't get to see you for a while!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think you're right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
He's been so anxious lately.
He even asked, “So, you're really going?” and, “It isn't a dangerous city, is it?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He must be concerned for your safety, Azusawa. It's kind of him to worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know. He's been telling me not to stay out late and avoid back alleys where people wouldn't normally go. I appreciate his concern...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But then he said, “Always head straight back to your room without taking any detours,” and, “Don't follow strangers.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, but it's like Toya said!
He's just worried about his little girl!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, what about you?
Did your mom say anything?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mine? Hmm... She told me to be careful and stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But my dad's already over there.
So, if anything does happen, I can call him or Uncle Taiga for help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is nice to know that you have family members already over there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Aoyagi, I'm glad that your dad said you could go. But I'm also a bit surprised.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, me too! I think we were all pretty stunned when you said he okayed it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It means he trusts me at least somewhat... So I'm glad he did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He trusts you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe my dad doesn't trust me, huh.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: First, he gave you permission to sing at live houses, and now he's letting you take a trip to the United States. He's worried, but he's not stopping you from going!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. He's allowing you to go with us on this trip, so I think he's just worried like any parent would be.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're probably right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And if he really starts to get on your case, you can just go, “so you don't trust me, is that it?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That should shut him up pretty quickly.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! Th-That'd be...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What?
All I did was tell her how to deal with someone who's being obnoxious.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's a pretty overpowered counter...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't recommend following his advice, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha...
My dad would be so deflated.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After we land, I plan to send messages regularly. That should put my dad at ease a little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great idea! You could even send pics of us having fun together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Dad's mentioned being interested in American cityscapes, so I should try to take as many photos as I can for him...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. This is going to be such a fun trip!)
